Earthquakes reported near Chile and China-Myanmar border

Two separate earthquakes were recorded by geological agencies. A magnitude 5.5 earthquake occurred near the coast of central Chile, as reported by GFZ. Separately, a magnitude 4.1 earthquake struck near the China-Myanmar border, according to NCS.
